id_and_class.summary: Wilson Van Dusen argued that mind is not contained in four-dimensional space-time but is literally extended in higher spatial dimensions: a five-dimensional alpha mind of events, a six-dimensional beta mind of ideas and tendencies, and a seven-dimensional gamma mind of reflection. The brain is the lower physical anchor of this structure, and consciousness is the sharply differentiated segment of each level.

conceptual_ground.explanatory_identity_claim: Mind is identical with operations in real spaces of five, six and seven dimensions; phenomenal awareness is the presence of contents in these spaces, and consciousness is their differentiation.
conceptual_ground.mind_body_relationship: Alpha mind holds non-physical representations of the body, including changing brain patterns; because a brain pattern and its sensed object share a time date, repeated pairing gives the pattern the object's meaning. This anchors mind to body without reducing either to the other.
conceptual_ground.emergence_type: Not applicable (mind is a real higher-dimensional entity, not a product of the brain)
conceptual_ground.subjectivity_and_intentionality: Van Dusen starts from ‘mind as it is experienced’ as the one indubitable datum. Gamma mind supplies apperception, the power to reflect on ideas and acts.
conceptual_ground.qualia_account: Phenomenal character is stratified: alpha contents have the particular detail of events, beta contents are no clearer than an abstract idea or general tendency, and gamma contents are the power of reflection without even that particularity.
conceptual_ground.ontological_commitments: Real spatial dimensions beyond four, mental entities built as series of lower-dimensional entities, a physical brain, and extrasensory perception.
conceptual_ground.epistemic_access: Phenomenological description of mind as experienced, combined with topology, mathematical logic and group theory.
conceptual_ground.constituents_and_structure: Alpha mind (5-space): events with past, present and future dates held together as memory, sensation and precognition. Beta mind (6-space): abstract ideas fused with tendencies such as habits, interests, fears, ego and conscience. Gamma mind (7-space): acts of reflection. Eight-space can be described as a series but not conceived.

mechanism_and_dynamics.scope_of_consciousness: Phenomenal awareness, access consciousness (as differentiation), the unconscious, memory, precognition, will and reflection.
mechanism_and_dynamics.distinctive_mechanism_or_principle: A generative rule from topology: an n-dimensional entity is a series of (n−1)-dimensional entities. A series of differently dated events has no physical counterpart, since any cut through physical happening yields a solid, so it must be mind.
mechanism_and_dynamics.location_and_distribution: Outside ordinary four-dimensional space-time, spanning at least seven dimensions, with the brain as its lowest physical anchor.
mechanism_and_dynamics.causation_and_functional_role: Beta-level tendencies can drive behavior without conscious choice; Van Dusen remarks that if this is will, it is blind will.
mechanism_and_dynamics.integration_or_binding: A five-dimensional entity gathers differently dated events into a single unity, which is how remembered, present and anticipated events coexist in mind.
mechanism_and_dynamics.information_flow_or_representation: All contents are present in mind at once and differ only in how sharply differentiated they are; consciousness is the narrow segment that stands out and the unconscious is the undifferentiated rest.
core_claims_and_evidence: Physical events are always four-dimensional, so a unity of differently dated events can exist only in mind.
Awareness (having contents present) runs continuously from full to no differentiation, which dissolves the psychoanalytic picture of conscious and unconscious as separate regions.
Whitehead's remark that thought halts before limitless complexity follows from defining consciousness as differentiation.
Van Dusen offered extrasensory perception, which he thought otherwise unexplained, as confirmation.
mechanism_and_dynamics.basis_of_belief_or_evidence_type: Mathematical and phenomenological argument, partly motivated by parapsychology.

empirics_and_critiques.criticisms_and_tensions: The theory identifies mathematical dimensionality with ontological levels of mind without arguing for the identification, and it stratifies phenomenal character without explaining why any level should be felt at all.
empirics_and_critiques.open_questions_and_limitations: Van Dusen judged his own theory neither fully acceptable nor rejectable, an outline that still needed internal elaboration and novel confirmed predictions.
empirics_and_critiques.ontological_coherence: Van Dusen rejected materialism, dualism, idealism and double-aspect views as unestablished and built a separate framework; its reliance on ESP and real extra dimensions puts it far from mainstream physics.

survival_beyond_death.rationale: Since mind lies mostly outside physical space-time and the brain is only its lower anchor, it follows from the view that mind need not end with the brain, though Van Dusen does not argue this here.
